LanguageData.DeltaV_Mission_Rules_Freight: Deliver within {0} days, followed by {1} days of grace. Pay the full deposit on acceptance, collect the crates from this station's pickup bay, and physically haul them into the receiving bay. Deliver at least one crate to close the contract. Undelivered deposits are forfeited. Opening a crate keeps its contents but disqualifies it from delivery, without a goodwill penalty. Success: +{2} goodwill; abandonment or expiry: {3}.
LanguageData.DeltaV_Mission_Rules_Passengers: Deliver within {0} days, followed by {1} days of grace at full reward. No deposit. Passengers are controllable and draftable but do no daily work. Bring them into the receiving station before handover; one delivery is enough to close the contract. Death, confirmed loss, harmful surgery, arrest or enslavement disqualifies only that passenger and costs {4} goodwill. The others continue travelling. Success: +{2} goodwill; abandonment or expiry: {3}.
LanguageData.DeltaV_Mission_Rules_Combat: Return here for payment once the specified ship no longer has a main console belonging to the enemy. A succeeding backup console still counts. No deadline; wrecks, captured ships and crew remain. Success: +{2} goodwill; abandonment: {3}.
